description: Extension of CanvasWindowController providing helper functions for session key sanitization, JavaScript string literal generation, frame loading and storing using UserDefaults.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A class extended here with utility helper functions for managing window frames and session keys.

methods.name: sanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Sanitizes a session key by trimming whitespace and replacing invalid characters with underscores, defaulting to 'main' if empty.

methods.name: jsStringLiteral
methods.description: Converts a String into a JSON-encoded JavaScript string literal.

methods.name: jsOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Converts an optional String into a JavaScript string literal or 'null' if nil.

methods.name: storedFrameDefaultsKey
methods.description: Generates a UserDefaults key for storing frame data, sanitized by the session key.

methods.name: loadRestoredFrame
methods.description: Loads a saved window frame (NSRect) from UserDefaults for a given session key, returning nil if invalid or too small.

methods.name: storeRestoredFrame
methods.description: Stores a window frame (NSRect) to UserDefaults using a session-specific key.
